# Содержимое файла blockListControl.ts {#sec-api-blockListControl .appendix}

``` python
import { Response, Request } from 'express';
import { createDb, getQuery, runQuery } from '../../db/queryDb';

type BlockListCountriesType = {
    clientId: number,
    countryCodes: string,
    getAll: boolean
}

type BlockListDomainsType = {
    clientId: number,
    domains: {
        label: string,
        type: "edit" | "insert" | "delete",
        oldLabel: string
    },
    getAll: boolean
}

export const getBlockListCountries = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const { clientId, countryCodes, getAll }: BlockListCountriesType = req.body;
    const db = createDb(res);

    try {
        await runQuery(
            db,
            `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS block_countries (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            clientId TEXT NOT NULL,
            countries_codes TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(clientId, countries_codes)
            )`,
            []
        );

        if (!!getAll) { 
            // Получение всего списка стран из ЧС
            const countries = await getQuery<{
                countries_codes: string
            }>(
                db,
                'SELECT countries_codes FROM block_countries WHERE clientId = ?',
                [clientId]
            );

            if (countries.length > 0) {
                res.json({ success: true, info: countries.map(c => c.countries_codes) });
            } else {
                res.json({ success: true, info: [] });
            }
        } else { 
            // Добавление/удаление списка стран
            await runQuery(db, 'DELETE FROM block_countries WHERE clientId = ?', [clientId]);

            if (countryCodes && countryCodes.trim().length > 0) {
                const codes = countryCodes.split(',');
                for (const code of codes) {
                    await runQuery(
                        db,
                        `INSERT INTO block_countries (clientId, countries_codes) VALUES (?, ?)`,
                        [clientId, code.trim()]
                    );
                }
            }
            res.json({ success: true });
        }

        db.close();
    } catch (e) {
        db.close();
        res.json({
            success: false,
            info: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        });
    }
}

export const getBlockListDomains = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const { clientId, domains, getAll }: BlockListDomainsType = req.body;
    const db = createDb(res);

    try {
        await runQuery(
            db,
            `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS block_domains (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            clientId TEXT NOT NULL,
            domains TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(clientId, domains)
            )`,
            []
        );

        if (!!getAll) { 
            // Получение всех доменов
            const getDomainsResp = await getQuery<{
                domains: string
            }>(
                db,
                'SELECT domains FROM block_domains WHERE clientId = ?',
                [clientId]
            );

            if (getDomainsResp.length > 0) {
                const getDomains = getDomainsResp.map((d, index) => {
                    return {
                        label: d.domains,
                        id: index
                    };
                });
                res.json({ success: true, info: getDomains });
            } else {
                res.json({ success: true, info: [] });
            }
        } else { 
            // Внесение изменений в домены 
            switch (domains.type) {
                case 'insert':
                    await runQuery(
                        db,
                        `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO block_domains (clientId, domains) VALUES (?, ?)`,
                        [clientId, domains.label]
                    );
                    break;
                case 'delete':
                    await runQuery(
                        db,
                        `DELETE FROM block_domains WHERE clientId = ? AND domains = ?`,
                        [clientId, domains.label]
                    );
                    break;
                case 'edit':
                    await runQuery(
                        db,
                        `UPDATE block_domains SET domains = ? WHERE clientId = ? AND domains = ?`,
                        [domains.label, clientId, domains.oldLabel]
                    );
                    break;
                default:
                    db.close();
                    return res.json({ success: false });
            }

            db.close();
            res.json({ success: true });
        }
    } catch (e) {
        db.close();
        res.json({
            success: false,
            info: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        });
    }
}
```
